labels.label:
PG_SFTP_KYRIBA - Kyriba SFTP Pipeline
Picks up Kyriba files from sftp.moneymart.ca and loads them into Snowflake (DLSTAGE_BRONZE.SFTP_KYRIBA).

There are 3 independent pipelines running in this group:

── ACH Report ──────────────────────────────────────────
Finds and downloads the ACH report file, strips the footer
line, stamps audit info, and loads into KYRIBA_ACH_REPORT.

── Payment Support (3 files, 3 tables) ─────────────────
Finds and downloads 3 payment support files, routes each
one by filename, strips header/footer rows, stamps audit
info, then loads into their respective tables:
  • BANK08 BKLGR file      → KYRIBA_BANK_ACCOUNT
  • BANK06 DATALAKE BAL file → KYRIBA_BANK_BALANCE
  • PAYMENT22 PD file      → KYRIBA_BANK_PAYMENT

── Borrow Base Bank (2 files, 2 tables) ────────────────
Same pattern as above but for 2 bank balance files:
  • DL_BANKBAL_PD file → KYRIBA_BANK_BALANCE_PD
  • DL_BANKBAL_CD file → KYRIBA_BANK_BALANCE_CD

All pipelines check for new files every minute (Primary Node
only) and will never re-process a file already seen.
Loads to Snowflake use managed auth with at-least-once delivery.
